item.description:
The first release of RawBoy Viewer: a mouse-first photo viewer and culling tool for macOS 15+, from the RawBoy family.
- Browser: folders, favourites, a thumbnail grid from the cameras' own previews, sort by shoot date, ratings bar and filters; cloud placeholders aren't downloaded by browsing; the folder updates itself when other apps change it. - Viewer: the photo fills the screen; the edges show actions (left), details with histogram and EXIF (right) and the filmstrip (top); the bottom of the photo goes to the previous / next photo. - Culling: stars, pick, reject in XMP sidecars RawBoy, Lightroom, Capture One and darktable read; `_bin`, Trash, undo. - Rotate, crop (kept the way RawBoy keeps it), export, compare 2–4 photos, slideshow, real RAW preview.
**Not notarized** (signed with a free Personal Team): the first time, right-click the app › Open, or System Settings › Privacy & Security › Open Anyway. Later versions arrive through Check for Updates.
